title: Stacked arithmetic (the `stack` template)

template.also: `fact.js` delegates to it for stacked + facts with a regroup row on paper (`drawsStack`); `screen-cell.js` draws the same cell on the practice card, online worksheet and quiz

summary: One stacked problem per boxed cell: digit tracks right-aligned under place-value heads, the operator in its own track, a 1.5 pt rule, an answer zone below it, regroup / carry boxes above the top number when the scaffold is on. Paper, key and the three screen hosts are one drawing.
teaches: The column (standard) algorithm for addition and subtraction of whole numbers, with and without regrouping, from two-digit numbers to four-digit numbers (three and four addends; across zeros), plus a missing digit in a stacked sum, difference or 1-digit product, and multiplying a multi-digit number by a 1-digit number in the column. Grades 1-4 (CCSS 1.NBT.C.4, 2.NBT.B.5-7, 3.NBT.A.2, 4.NBT.B.4-5; WRM Y2-Y5 column methods).
research: From repo sources (PEDAGOGY_STANDARD L-3 to L-5Z, design/PROBLEM_TYPES.md AS / MU rows, design/catalogue/addition.md and subtraction.md); MW4K/IXL research pending logins (Q-H4).
problemTypes: AS-05 vertical add / subtract with labelled columns (H T O letters, regroup boxes above, answer zone below) — the core item
AS-10 mixed regroup / no-regroup set (P-10 non-examples) and AS-14 mixed-sign set (ring the sign first)
AS-07 column sum of three or four addends, ragged lengths (`add_column_multi`)
AS-16 / MU-15 missing digit in a stacked + − × (one dashed digit box, LS-8)
AS-09 regroup notation only (cross out, write one less, write the new ones); then across zeros (L-5Z)
AS-11 / MU-11 rewrite a horizontal problem in the grid (alignment), then solve
AS-15 check a subtraction by adding (`check` line under the stack)
MU-09 multi-digit × 1-digit in the grid with a carry row (2 × 2 digits and up belong to `long-multiplication`)
progression: 2-digit + and − with no regrouping, T O letters, answer boxes (L-3 1-4)
the T O letters fade; the grid stays (L-3 7); add or subtract a 1-digit number, ones under ones (L-3 8)
decide: does this one regroup? (check box, no computing) (L-4 2, L-5 2)
regroup notation only: the ten into the box / cross out and write one less (L-4 3, L-5 4)
2-digit with regrouping, boxes on every item, no-regroup items mixed in (L-4 4, L-5 5)
3-digit: regroup the ones, then the tens, then twice; the answer that needs a new place (L-4 7-10, L-5 10-12)
4-digit with a comma in the answer; three and four addends (L-4 11-12, L-5 13)
the regroup boxes fade on a dedicated step only (L-4 13, L-5 6)
subtracting across zeros, one change per step: whole ten, hundred, thousand, one zero, two zeros, zeros in the middle (L-5Z Z1-Z7)
missing digit (one, then two), check by the inverse, and × 1-digit with a carry row

drawing.sizes: digits 16 / 22 / 28 pt; writing height Hw 6 / 8 / 10 mm; answer row 8 / 10 / 12 mm; heads row 4 / 5 / 6 mm; regroup row 6 / 7 / 8 mm; carry box 5 / 6 / 7 mm; subtraction headroom 8 / 10 / 12 mm (`js/modules/sheet/tokens.js` SIZES). Tracks 0.72 em plain, 0.95 em with any regroup scaffold (TY-20, TY-21); default size L.
notes: Payload (`q.cell = {template: 'stack', v: 1, payload}`): `operands` (2 to 4 rows), `op`, `ans`, `regroup` ('add' | 'sub' | false), `heads`, `answer`, `unknown` {row, index}, `ansDigits`, `check`, `supports`. The scaffold ladder (level 3-0) decides heads, regroup and answer boxes, never the generator (SCC-Q10).
States blank / traced / answered / wrong share one geometry (SCC-T10). On a key and a traced Model the regroup boxes hold the working and the regrouped top digits are crossed (AK-2 over VA-13).
Screen: one input per answer track in the printed geometry, regroup boxes as ungraded inputs, the missing digit as an input (SCC-T15, SP-23).

ruleGroups.title: Hard caps and criteria (RUBRIC; every page)

ownerRulings.ruling: "Within N" bounds the ANSWER (the sum, the minuend), never the operands.
Dashed box = the unknown digit in a missing-digit stack; regroup boxes stay solid (LS-8).
General regrouping is secure before any zero is regrouped across; L-5Z changes only the zeros, one step at a time.
Writing boxes are slightly rounded (SL-11); a row of digit boxes is ONE outline with dividers (SL-12).
Every key (practice, mixed, independent) fills the regroup / carry boxes with the full working and crosses the old digit (AK-2 over VA-13).
Key answers print reddish orange, keys only (INK-31).
Touch-dot column stacks keep the greys of earlier columns; "Touched N" stays on × stacks.

SPEC, NOT BUILT (held for Lane B): on screen the regroup boxes an item needs are required and marked; a right subtraction regroup number crosses the old digit live; option marked (default) / unmarked / optional; paper unchanged. This changes VA-13, SCC-T17 and SP-23 for screen hosts.

SPEC, NOT BUILT: option `carry: top | bottom` — carries UNDER the answer line, one column left, in a box about two-thirds of a digit box; addition (incl. 3-4 addends) and × only; subtraction stays at the top; off by default; a layout preference, not a preset skill (build list `vis_carry_below`).

misconceptions.error: writes the whole column total, no regroup
takes the smaller digit from the larger in each column
regroups the ones but does not make the tens one less
across zeros: regroups the hundreds but leaves the tens at ten
ragged lengths: lines the 1-digit number up under the tens
missing digit: ignores the regrouped ten (answer off by one)

options: Declared today per skill: §7b, after the Signed line (informational, not signed). The ladder in O-rubric terms: O2 number size by digits / within N (answer-bounded) and regroup never / some / every; O3 support = heads, regroup boxes, touch dots, start arrow (hints fade, the grid stays); O6 stacked / across.

Pending options from owner rulings: `carry: top | bottom` (vis_carry_below), regroup boxes marked / unmarked / optional on screen (REGROUP-BOXES-SPEC), decimal-point track `dp` and the expanded form (vis_stack_layouts). Each is a plain option, not a preset skill, unless it teaches a new size class (CLAUDE.md distinct-option rule).

openQuestions.q: Does this card also cover × 1-digit (`multiply`, `mult_missing_digit`) and the column-mult presets, or do they wait for the `long-multiplication` card?
openQuestions.recommended: This card covers × by 1 digit in the stack (MU-09, MU-15); 2-digit multipliers and partial-product rows go on the `long-multiplication` card.

openQuestions.q: Under-the-line carry box size (CARRY-BELOW-SPEC: about two-thirds of a digit box): what is the floor at S?
openQuestions.recommended: Two-thirds of the answer row (5.3 / 6.7 / 8 mm) and one track wide, never under the 4.4 mm regroup-segment floor; the row adds to the cell height and capacity is re-checked (content never shrinks, SCC-T4).

openQuestions.q: When the screen regroup boxes become required (REGROUP-BOXES-SPEC), VA-13, SCC-T17 and SP-23 say the opposite. Rewrite them in the same change?
openQuestions.recommended: Yes: rewrite the three rules for screen hosts only (paper unchanged) in the same commit; this card then fails its coverage test until regenerated with --resign and signed again.

openQuestions.q: Are regroup boxes a structural scaffold (stay at every level) or a hint (fade)?
openQuestions.recommended: Structural: they stay at every level and are removed only on the dedicated fade step (L-4 step 13, L-5 step 6), chosen by the support option, never by the scaffold level.

openQuestions.q: Decimal column add / subtract (`add_decimal`, `sub_decimal`, legacy `decimal-column-*`) move onto the stack with a decimal-point track (vis_stack_layouts): this card or a decimals card?
openQuestions.recommended: This card, as option `dp: 1..3` (VA-40 to VA-42 already listed); the decimals family card only names it.

openQuestions.q: MW4K / IXL research is pending logins (Q-H4). Sign now?
openQuestions.recommended: Yes, sign now; add the research to section 2 when the logins work, and re-sign only if the problem types or progression change.
